verdict.rationale: SumUp's first-party refund guide documents both full and partial refunds of previously processed payments via its API (Option A full refund, Option B partial refund). The evidence does not show refunds initiated from the point of sale or the dashboard, and it does not explicitly state that funds return to the original card. missing for 10: POS-initiated refunds, dashboard refunds, explicit return-to-original-card documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can issue full or partial refunds back to the original card from the point of sale, dashboard, or API

citations.quote: In this guide, you will learn how to refund a transaction... Option A: Make a full refund... Option B: Make a partial refund
When you complete these steps, the payment you have previously processed through SumUp will be refunded either partially or in full.
